title: Identifying backsplash galaxies using machine learning
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables, submitted to MNRAS; link to associated web app in Conclusions of paper
summary: The galaxy population in the outskirts of a cluster contains members that have been pre-processed in groups and filaments, as well as backsplash galaxies -- those that have recently passed through the cluster's center. However, disentangling these two pathways is challenging observationally. In this work, we present a machine-learning-powered model, trained on simulations of galaxy clusters from The Three Hundred suite of simulations, which can identify individual backsplash galaxies in astronomical observations. This model can build samples of backsplash galaxies with a purity and completeness of up to ~70%, and galaxies on their first infall with a purity and completeness of over 80%. It can be tuned to optimise either of these two metrics, and can be used with any combination of a set of observable quantities. We have also applied this model to galaxies with asymmetric HI distributions in the Virgo Cluster, and have demonstrated that these galaxies are all likely approaching the cluster for the first time. This supports the idea that cold gas is removed from these galaxies soon after entering a cluster, and demonstrates how this classifier can provide a better understanding of which properties of galaxies are caused by a previous passage through a cluster. We have made this model publicly available in the form of a web app, with a link in the Conclusions of this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习模型（基于The Three Hundred模拟训练）识别星系团外围的backsplash星系，纯度和完备度可达~70%，首次坠入星系纯度和完备度超80%。应用于室女座星系团中HI分布不对称星系，发现它们均为首次坠入，表明冷气体在进入星系团后很快被剥离。模型已公开为Web应用。
AI.motivation: 星系团外围的星系包含两类：在群/纤维结构中经历预处理的星系，以及近期穿过星系团中心的backsplash星系。观测上难以区分这两类星系，因此需要一种方法有效识别backsplash星系。
AI.method: 基于The Three Hundred模拟套件训练机器学习模型，利用可观测的星系属性组合，识别backsplash星系和首次坠入星系。
AI.result: 模型识别backsplash星系的纯度和完备度可达~70%，首次坠入星系的纯度和完备度超80%。应用于室女座星系团中HI分布不对称星系，发现它们均为首次坠入。
AI.conclusion: 模型可有效区分backsplash星系与首次坠入星系；室女座星系团中HI不对称星系均为首次坠入，支持冷气体在进入星系团后迅速被剥离的观点；模型已公开为Web应用供学界使用。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 星系团外围的星系群体包含那些在群和纤维结构中经历过预处理的成员，以及回溅星系——即最近穿过星系团中心的星系。然而，在观测上区分这两种路径具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于机器学习的模型，该模型使用来自“The Three Hundred”星系团模拟套件的模拟数据进行训练，能够在天文观测中识别单个回溅星系。该模型可以构建纯度与完备度高达约70%的回溅星系样本，以及纯度与完备度超过80%的首次坠入星系样本。它可以调整以优化这两个指标中的任意一个，并且可以与一组可观测量的任意组合一起使用。我们还将该模型应用于室女座星系团中具有不对称HI分布的星系，并证明这些星系很可能都是首次接近星系团。这支持了冷气体在进入星系团后不久就被剥离的观点，并展示了该分类器如何帮助我们更好地理解哪些星系性质是由先前穿过星系团造成的。我们已将该模型以Web应用程序的形式公开提供，链接见本文结论部分。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要，模型可有效区分回溅星系与首次坠入星系；室女座星系团中HI不对称星系均为首次坠入，支持冷气体在进入星系团后迅速被剥离的观点；模型已公开为Web应用供学界使用。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Plot showing region of cluster-centric phase space stated to contain backsplash galaxies, from a selection of previous works in the literature (Muriel and Coenda, 2014 ; Rhee et al. , 2017 ; Ferreras et al. , 2023 ; Martínez et al. , 2023 ) . In each case, the ‘backsplash region’ is the region below these lines. In some of these cases (Rhee et al. , 2017 ; Ferreras et al. , 2023 ) , the backsplash region extends to radii outside of the range \([R_{200},2R_{200}]\) , but as our work only studies this range, we only plot the constraints within this radial range.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：展示文献中先前工作（Muriel and Coenda, 2014；Rhee et al., 2017；Ferreras et al., 2023；Martínez et al., 2023）所选定的包含回溅星系的星系团中心相空间区域。在每种情况下，“回溅区域”是这些线以下的区域。在某些情况下（Rhee et al., 2017；Ferreras et al., 2023），回溅区域延伸至\([R_{200},2R_{200}]\)范围之外的半径，但由于我们的工作仅研究此范围，我们仅绘制此径向范围内的约束条件。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Relative importance of all 14 measurable quantities in classifying backsplash galaxies, plus a random number generator as a baseline measurement. This is used to identify metrics that provide no classifying power, which are shown as unfilled circles.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：所有14个可测量量在分类回溅星系时的相对重要性，外加一个随机数生成器作为基线测量。这用于识别不提供分类能力的指标，这些指标以空心圆表示。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Confusion matrix of classifier when using all 14 measurable quantities. Each panel shows fraction of galaxy sample in the test set of data that are classified correctly/incorrectly as backsplash/infalling galaxies.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：使用所有14个可测量量时分类器的混淆矩阵。每个面板显示了测试数据集中被正确/错误分类为回溅/坠入星系的星系样本比例。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Backsplash fraction as a function of projected distance from the cluster centre, \(d_{{proj}}\) , in units of the cluster radius, \(R_{200}\) , and line-of-sight velocity relative to the cluster centre, \(v_{{LOS}}\) , in units of the line-of-sight cluster velocity dispersion, \(\sigma\) . Left panel shows the true fraction of backsplash galaxies in our training set. Centre panel shows the fraction from our test set, predicted using the random forest classifier we develop in this work; this instance uses the minimal classifier, trained only on projected distance, line-of-sight velocity, and cluster magnitude gap. Right panel shows an example of an alternative classification method, based on regions of phase space. The classification shown comes from R17 , but any of those displayed in Fig. 1 would give a similar result. The left and centre panels show a kernel density estimation (KDE) of the backsplash fraction, and the right panel shows the backsplash fraction imposed by the phase-space classification rule.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：回溅星系比例作为距星系团中心投影距离\(d_{{proj}}\)（以星系团半径\(R_{200}\)为单位）和相对于星系团中心的视向速度\(v_{{LOS}}\)（以视向星系团速度弥散\(\sigma\)为单位）的函数。左图显示训练集中回溅星系的真实比例。中图显示使用本文开发的随机森林分类器预测的测试集比例；此实例使用仅基于投影距离、视向速度和星系团星等差的最小分类器。右图显示基于相空间区域的替代分类方法示例。所示分类来自R17，但图1中显示的任何一种都会给出类似结果。左图和中间图显示回溅比例的核密度估计（KDE），右图显示由相空间分类规则强加的回溅比例。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Purity and completeness of backsplash (left) and infalling (centre) samples, as a function of backsplash galaxy threshold value. Right panel shows the overall accuracy of the model as a function of the threshold value. Vertical line represents the fiducial threshold value, \({p(Backsplash)}=0.61\) , as described in Section 2.3.1 . Shaded regions are the uncertainties derived by bootstrapping from a binomial distribution.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：回溅（左）和坠入（中）样本的纯度与完备度，作为回溅星系阈值值的函数。右图显示模型总体准确度作为阈值值的函数。垂直线代表基准阈值值\({p(Backsplash)}=0.61\)，如第2.3.1节所述。阴影区域是通过从二项分布进行自举推导出的不确定性。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Equivalent figures to Fig. 4 (top row) and Fig. 5 (bottom row), with the addition of the velocity direction projected in the plane of the sky, \(\theta_{{v}}\) . Top row shows the backsplash fraction as a function of position-velocity phase space for the true sample of simulated backsplash galaxies (left), those identified by our classifier (centre), and those selected with a hard phase-space cut (right). Bottom row shows the purity and completeness of the produced backsplash (left) and infalling galaxy (centre) samples, and the accuracy of the model (right).
figures.caption_zh: 图6：与图4（上行）和图5（下行）等效的图，增加了投影在天空平面上的速度方向\(\theta_{{v}}\)。上行显示模拟回溅星系真实样本（左）、我们的分类器识别的样本（中）以及使用硬相空间截断选择的样本（右）的位置-速度相空间中的回溅比例。下行显示生成的回溅（左）和坠入星系（右）样本的纯度与完备度，以及模型的准确度（右）。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Summary of results in Section 3 . The accuracy of each of our five test cases is shown, and the purity, \(\pazocal{P}\) , and completeness, \(\pazocal{C}\) , of the samples of backsplash and infalling galaxies they produce. Also included is the optimal classification threshold, as defined in Section 2.3.1 , to achieve this performance. For comparison, the performance of two existing methods based on phase-space information are included, one with a restrictive definition of backsplash galaxies (Rhee et al. , 2017 ) , and one with a less restrictive definition (Ferreras et al. , 2023 ) . We again note that the random forest model presented in this work can be controlled to be more or less restrictive, to produce samples of galaxies with a greater purity and lower completeness, or vice-versa.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：第3节结果总结。展示了五个测试案例中每一个的准确度，以及它们产生的回溅和坠入星系样本的纯度\(\pazocal{P}\)和完备度\(\pazocal{C}\)。还包括实现此性能的最佳分类阈值，如第2.3.1节所定义。作为比较，包含了两种基于相空间信息的现有方法的性能，一种对回溅星系有严格定义（Rhee et al., 2017），另一种有较宽松定义（Ferreras et al., 2023）。我们再次指出，本文提出的随机森林模型可以控制为更严格或更宽松，以产生纯度更高、完备度更低或反之的星系样本。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Example cluster from The300 simulations (ID: cluster_0141 ). Left panel shows the mass distribution of gas in this cluster, right panel shows the distribution of stars. The large white circles represent distances of \(R_{200}\) and \(2R_{200}\) from the cluster centre. The right panel shows backsplash galaxies and infalling galaxies identified by our model, along with their status as true/false backsplash/infalling galaxies. Circles represent galaxies the model identifies as backsplash, and triangles are galaxies identified as first-time infallers. Light green markers represent correct predictions, dark blue markers are incorrect predictions. For example, a dark blue triangle is a backsplash galaxy that the model incorrectly identifies as an infalling galaxy – a ‘false infaller’.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：来自The300模拟的示例星系团（ID: cluster_0141）。左图显示该星系团中气体的质量分布，右图显示恒星的分布。大白色圆圈代表距星系团中心\(R_{200}\)和\(2R_{200}\)的距离。右图显示我们的模型识别的回溅星系和坠入星系，以及它们作为真/假回溅/坠入星系的状态。圆圈代表模型识别为回溅的星系，三角形代表识别为首次坠入的星系。浅绿色标记代表正确预测，深蓝色标记代表错误预测。例如，深蓝色三角形是模型错误识别为坠入星系的回溅星系——即“假坠入者”。

title: Tracing the Cosmic web across Cosmic time through SKA observations of radio galaxies
comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII), 2026 (arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no:AASKAII/Dabhade01. Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII) outlines the transformative scientific advances that wilL be enabled by the SKA telescopes
summary: The Square Kilometre Array will transform studies of the cosmic web by tracing radio galaxies (RGs) and star-forming systems across cosmic time with unprecedented sensitivity, angular resolution, frequency coverage, and survey speed. Powered by accreting supermassive black holes, RGs are not only signposts of AGN feedback but also incisive probes of their environments, from dense clusters to the low-density intergalactic medium. Their lobes, magnetic fields, and energy outflows encode the thermal and non-thermal histories of the surrounding gas, offering diagnostics of IGM pressure, particle ageing, and magnetisation over megaparsec scales. With its broad frequency coverage (50 MHz-15 GHz), microJy to sub-microJy continuum sensitivity, and wide field of view, the SKA will detect vast radio-source populations across broad ranges of redshift and environment. Measurements of source size, morphology, spectral ageing, radio power, polarisation, and Faraday rotation will reveal how the environment regulates jet propagation and lobe evolution, how radio plasma heats and magnetises the intracluster and intergalactic media, and how early AGN activity influences galaxy growth and star formation in protoclusters. Combined with host identifications, spectroscopic redshifts, and optical, infrared, X-ray, Sunyaev--Zel'dovich, and cosmic-web catalogues, SKA observations will place RGs within their three-dimensional large-scale environments. This chapter presents a framework for using RGs to trace and probe the cosmic web, from nearby filaments and clusters to high-redshift protoclusters, and to test how environment, magnetic fields, feedback, and gas dynamics shape radio-galaxy evolution, protocluster assembly, and star formation across cosmic time.

AI.tldr: 本文阐述了平方千米阵（SKA）将如何通过观测射电星系（RGs）的前所未有的灵敏度、角分辨率和频率覆盖，来研究宇宙网结构、星系团/星系际介质特性以及射电星系演化，并提出了利用RGs追踪宇宙网、探测环境反馈和磁场演化的研究框架。
AI.motivation: SKA将彻底变革对宇宙网的研究，利用射电星系作为探针，揭示从稠密星系团到低密度星系际介质的环境信息，以及AGN反馈、磁场和气体动力学在宇宙时间尺度上的作用。
AI.method: 利用SKA的宽频覆盖（50 MHz-15 GHz）、微Jy级连续谱灵敏度和广视场，通过测量射电源的尺寸、形态、光谱老化、射电功率、偏振和法拉第旋转等参数，并结合多波段（光学、红外、X射线、SZ效应等）巡天数据进行宿主星系识别和三维环境定位。
AI.result: SKA将探测超大范围的射电源种群，揭示环境如何调控喷流传播和瓣演化，射电等离子体如何加热和磁化星系团内介质及星系际介质，以及早期AGN活动如何影响原星系团中的星系生长和恒星形成。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个利用射电星系追踪和探测宇宙网（从近邻纤维/星系团到高红移原星系团）的框架，旨在检验环境、磁场、反馈和气体动力学如何共同塑造射电星系演化、原星系团组装以及宇宙时间尺度上的恒星形成。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 平方公里阵列将通过前所未有的灵敏度、角分辨率、频率覆盖范围和巡天速度，利用射电星系和恒星形成系统追踪宇宙时间尺度上的宇宙网。由吸积的超大质量黑洞提供能量的射电星系不仅是活动星系核反馈的标志，也是其环境（从致密星系团到低密度星系际介质）的敏锐探针。它们的射电瓣、磁场和能量外流编码了周围气体的热和非热历史，提供了在兆秒差距尺度上对星系际介质压力、粒子老化和磁化的诊断。凭借其宽频率覆盖范围（50 MHz-15 GHz）、微央斯基到亚微央斯基的连续谱灵敏度和宽视场，平方公里阵列将探测到跨越广泛红移和环境范围的巨大射电源种群。对源大小、形态、频谱老化、射电功率、偏振和法拉第旋转的测量将揭示环境如何调节喷流传播和射电瓣演化，射电等离子体如何加热和磁化星系团内介质和星系际介质，以及早期活动星系核活动如何影响原星系团中的星系增长和恒星形成。结合宿主星系识别、光谱红移以及光学、红外、X射线、苏尼亚耶夫-泽尔多维奇效应和宇宙网星表，平方公里阵列的观测将把射电星系置于其三维大尺度环境中。本章提出了一个利用射电星系追踪和探测宇宙网（从近邻纤维和星系团到高红移原星系团）的框架，并检验环境、磁场、反馈和气体动力学如何共同塑造射电星系演化、原星系团组装以及宇宙时间尺度上的恒星形成。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要，本文提出了一个利用射电星系追踪和探测宇宙网（从近邻纤维/星系团到高红移原星系团）的框架，旨在检验环境、磁场、反馈和气体动力学如何共同塑造射电星系演化、原星系团组装以及宇宙时间尺度上的恒星形成。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Angular-resolution limits for morphological identification of radio galaxies/quasars with representative SKA1 observing bands. The curves show the minimum projected linear size required for a source to span five synthesised beams, adopted here as a practical criterion for recognising extended or double-lobed radio morphology. The calculation uses the angular-diameter distance as a function of redshift and representative SKA1 beam sizes: \(8.9^{\prime\prime}\) for SKA1-Low at 158 MHz, \(0.7^{\prime\prime}\) for SKA1-Mid at 770 MHz, \(0.4^{\prime\prime}\) for SKA1-Mid at 1.4 GHz, and \(0.08^{\prime\prime}\) for SKA1-Mid at 6.7 GHz (Braun et al. , 2019 ) . The shaded horizontal regions indicate approximate source-size regimes: compact radio sources below \(\sim 10\) kpc, normal or extended radio sources between \(\sim 10\) and \(700\) kpc, and giant radio sources above \(\sim 700\) kpc. Sources lying above a given curve are large enough, in angular-resolution terms, to be morphologically resolved in that band, whereas sources below the curve would require higher angular resolution for reliable structural classification. This figure illustrates that SKA1-Mid at 1.4 GHz can resolve tens-of-kpc-scale radio galaxies over a large fraction of cosmic time, while higher-frequency SKA1-Mid observations probe compact radio structures, and SKA1-Low is primarily suited to large, diffuse, steep-spectrum systems. These limits describe angular resolvability only; detectability will also depend on surface brightness, signal-to-noise ratio, spectral shape, and imaging strategy. The angular-to-linear conversion uses the angular-diameter distance derived from the comoving distance at each redshift, assuming a flat \(\Lambda\) CDM cosmology with \(H_{0}=67.4~{km~s^{-1}~Mpc^{-1}}\) , \(\Omega_{{m}}=0.315\) , and \(\Omega_{\Lambda}=0.685\) (Planck Collaboration et al. , 2020 ) .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：代表性SKA1观测波段下射电星系/类星体形态识别的角分辨率极限。曲线表示源跨越五个综合波束所需的最小投影线性尺寸，此处作为识别延展或双瓣射电形态的实用判据。计算使用了作为红移函数的角直径距离和代表性SKA1波束尺寸：158 MHz处SKA1-Low的\(8.9^{\prime\prime}\)，770 MHz处SKA1-Mid的\(0.7^{\prime\prime}\)，1.4 GHz处SKA1-Mid的\(0.4^{\prime\prime}\)，以及6.7 GHz处SKA1-Mid的\(0.08^{\prime\prime}\)（Braun et al. , 2019）。阴影水平区域表示近似的源尺寸范围：\(\sim 10\) kpc以下的致密射电源，\(\sim 10\)至\(700\) kpc之间的正常或延展射电源，以及\(\sim 700\) kpc以上的巨型射电源。位于给定曲线上方的源在角分辨率方面足够大，可以在该波段进行形态分辨，而曲线下方的源则需要更高的角分辨率才能进行可靠的结构分类。该图说明，SKA1-Mid在1.4 GHz处可以在宇宙时间的大部分范围内分辨数十千秒差距尺度的射电星系，而更高频率的SKA1-Mid观测则探测致密射电结构，SKA1-Low主要适用于大型、弥散、陡谱系统。这些极限仅描述了角可分辨性；可探测性还将取决于表面亮度、信噪比、频谱形状和成像策略。角-线性转换使用了从每个红移处的共动距离导出的角直径距离，假设平坦的\(\Lambda\) CDM宇宙学，其中\(H_{0}=67.4~{km~s^{-1}~Mpc^{-1}}\)，\(\Omega_{{m}}=0.315\)，以及\(\Omega_{\Lambda}=0.685\)（Planck Collaboration et al. , 2020）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Projected view of the low-redshift cosmic web, covering \(12^{\circ}\times 8^{\circ}\) within \(0.120\leq z Tempel et al. ( 2014 ) are plotted at their catalogue sky positions and colour-coded by median filament redshift. Their projected extents follow the catalogue geometry, while the displayed line widths are illustrative and do not represent physical filament widths. Galaxy clusters from Wen and Han ( 2015 , 2024 ) are shown as circles corresponding to \(R_{500}\) and are also colour-coded by redshift. FR I, FR II, and wide-angle-tail radio galaxies are compiled from the Capetti et al. ( 2017b , a ) , Mahato et al. ( 2026 ) , Goyal et al. ( 2026 ) , and Missaglia et al. ( 2019 ) catalogues and represented by schematic morphology icons, with the surrounding haloes indicating source redshift. The icon orientations are randomised for visual clarity and do not represent measured radio position angles, while their plotted sizes are not proportional to the true angular extents of the sources. This two-dimensional representation places different radio-galaxy morphologies within their broader cosmic-web environments. The redshift selection supports genuine three-dimensional proximity, although detailed membership and interaction require source-by-source analysis; the sample is not statistically complete or homogeneous. The cosmological parameters adopted here are the same as those used in Fig. 1 .

(2026)、Goyal et al. (2026)和Missaglia et al. (2019)星表，并以示意性形态图标表示，周围的光晕表示源红移。图标方向为随机化以便于视觉清晰，不代表测量的射电位置角，而其绘制大小与源的真实角尺度不成比例。这种二维表示将不同的射电星系形态置于其更广泛的宇宙网环境中。红移选择支持真正的三维邻近性，尽管详细的成员关系和相互作用需要逐源分析；该样本在统计上不完整或不均匀。此处采用的宇宙学参数与图1相同。
